value.summary: This pull request bumps the vendored openhuman and tinyhivemind submodules and adapts to their breaking changes. The openhuman change is a mechanical rename from `openhuman_core::openhuman` to `openhuman_core` as the package moved into a sub-crate. The tinyhivemind change migrates from one-turn-per-step to multi-turn rounds, updating the episode loop to run a round's turns in series, bound the pinboard to the round start to prevent intra-round leaks, and commit state only after all turns in the round are durable. The test fixtures are updated to match the new `HiveTurn::Speak` shape. The diff looks sound; no reportable defects found.
